source: The mockup's four schools (SC in plans/ledger-ui/design/mockup.html at atm dev 742105b64, the frozen disclosure-v2 mockup) run headless with happy-dom on 2026-11-05, as src/fixtures/members.ts serves them through MembersReader (src/data/members.ts); audiences per src/data/disclosure.ts (Audience, Disclosure) and spec v2.
notes: Route: #/<school>/members?show=&role=&plan=&member=&as=. show is attention or canceled (the status chips), role is admins or members (the Role chips), plan is a tier name (the chip the Plans tab opens, S3), member is a person id (the drawer), as is the audience being viewed (shared contract). Search text is not in the route. root.dataset.route is set once the tab (and the drawer, when member= is set) shows that route's data.

Data: src/data/members.ts (MembersReader, MembersWriter) and src/fixtures/members.ts. People are listed by attention score (2 per bad reason, 1 per warn), then role (owner, admin, member), then name; a role holder with no plan has 'No plan' in the plan cell and 'no plan' in the available cell, never 0.

Hooks and attributes: members-stat carries data-stat (outstanding, income, attention; attention is a button that applies the attention filter) with stat-label and stat-value inside. member-filter data-filter (all, attention, canceled) and role-filter data-role-filter (all, admins, members) carry class 'on' when selected; role-filter also aria-pressed; its text is the label, a space and the count. members-column data-column (member, role, plan, available, bar, expires, actions). member-row data-id. role-chip data-role and the mockup classes 'krole kr-<role>'; finance-chip class 'kfin'; audience-chip data-audience and title 'Audience: <reason>'. attention-badge data-kind (Person.attention kinds); status-badge for 'Canceled' and 'Cancels Dec 1'. balance-bar has the title 'used U · held H · available A', class 'low' when nothing is available or under 20% of granted, and three bar-segment children with data-segment (used, held, available) and data-count. member-available is the whole cell: '<available>[ → <pending>]/<granted>[ +<held> held]' with pending-badge (title 'Shows after the pending change ships') and held-badge (title 'Held for upcoming bookings') inside.

The ⋯ menu: member-menu (role=menu) holds member-menu-item buttons (role=menuitem) with data-action view-as-member, invoice, adjust, refund, release, switch, cancel or resume, make-admin, remove-admin or remove-owner, grant-finance or revoke-finance, csv, audit, stripe, receipt; groups are separated by hr; a destructive item has class 'd'; an action that is not allowed is disabled with the reason as its title. The row's and the drawer's ⋯ (member-menu-button, aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded) open the same menu.

The drawer: member-drawer with drawer-head ('<id> · <school>'), drawer-name (and you-tag), role-chip, finance-chip, member-plan, attention-badge, renews-badge, capability-line data-line (sees, money, audience), drawer-action data-action (view-as-member, invoice, adjust, refund), drawer-note (the owner-role lines), drawer-balance, drawer-booking rows with booking-action buttons (data-action confirm, noshow, release, refund, remind; data-booking), drawer-payments with payment-row (5, then payments-all) and payments-csv, drawer-history with history-item (5; data-pending on a pending one) or history-empty.

Modals: modal with modal-title, modal-subtitle, modal-body (the role modal's sentence, the resume text), modal-note (the role modal's refresh line), modal-preview, modal-field data-field (type, delta, note; item, memo; payment, amount, typed; waive; tier, quantity; when, reason) and modal-field-label data-field (data-value for the two 'when' radios), modal-fill-rest, modal-confirm, modal-cancel; release-option data-booking in the release picker. Select option values: type goodwill, gift, correction; item the addonId; payment the paymentIntentId; tier the tier id; quantity the number; the when radios period_end and now. Selects and inputs react to the input event (the runner's fill).

Writes: each action sends exactly the MembersWriter call its entry lists. While the call is pending (writer 'hold') the modal stays open with modal-confirm disabled and aria-busy=true (a quick release keeps the picker open with that release-option busy; a drawer booking action makes that button busy) and no toast is rendered; once it resolves the modal closes, the toast shows (toast is rendered only while it shows) and the pending effect appears: an adjust adds to available ('→ N'); a release returns held credits to available, a forfeit or an attended booking moves them to used; a booking reason drops while its booking has a pending write; the history gets the event first with 'just now · you · ships within 5 min'; a role or grant change updates the chips at once (a role-only person who loses their role leaves the list); a switch or cancel makes Switch, Cancel and Resume wait ('A change is already on its way').

Audiences: the roster shows to finance and owner only. Below, the tab renders lock-panel data-lock=admins_only with lock-title and lock-text (membersLock) and nothing else of the tab. Viewing as anyone but yourself is a preview: every write control is disabled with the title 'Exit preview to act'. A viewer may preview only audiences they hold (src/data/disclosure.ts); as=owner by a finance admin is their own view.

Money is formatted with Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency }) from minor units; dates as the mockup writes them ('Dec 1', 'Nov 1, 26' in the payments, 'Nov 4 · family' in the history), in the school's time zone.

moves.rule: Paths into each school's MembersFixture (src/fixtures/members.ts). A number is multiplied by the factor; a string gets ' <factor>' appended. An entry's (or a step's) expect.moves lists selectors of its text expectations whose text must still exist, pass the absent list and differ.
